cases.title: Payments lists the IR's waiting payment report and offers Answer it
steps: Press Harsha Bhat on the sign-in screen
expected: A card titled 'Payment reports waiting on Finance' shows 1 report.
The report reads Balance, ₹22.5 L, RTGS and offers 'Answer it'.

cases.title: Answering the report from Payments clears the card
steps: Press Harsha Bhat on the sign-in screen
expected: Payments opens on the bank statement upload and the register, with 15 receipts, and no 'Payment reports waiting on Finance' card above them.

cases.title: Compliance sees no payment reports on Payments
steps: Press Fahad Rizvi on the sign-in screen
expected: The page does not mention payment reports waiting on Finance.
